findings.oracle: Real sentinel string 'audit3-smoke-7f3a2b9c' is written to the live Windows clipboard; _parse_changed_records extracts the pipe-delimited record and asserts record['format']=='Text', record['preview']==sentinel, record['size_bytes']==str(len(sentinel.encode('utf-8'))), and datetime.fromisoformat(record['timestamp']).tzinfo is not None — four independently derived expected values the old existence-only check could never catch.

test_refresh_error_signal_delivers_payload_through_connected_slot connects a real slot, emits the payload string 'Refresh failed: ProcessManager unavailable', pumps the Qt event loop via _pump_until, and asserts received==[payload] exactly; also asserts emit(object()) raises TypeError — proves signal arity, type, and delivery, not mere attribute presence.
